reason: As the tech lead with 400 flags, A lets me operate the report in the first screen, shows why flags are left off the list, and says up front that output and option names are illustrative and that I make the edits in my own PR; as the founder I would ship it tomorrow. B has the clearer headline and a very believable terminal transcript, but its phone rendering clips the evidence and its middle sections are template. Evidence that A's length loses a one-minute reader, or a fix to B's mobile transcript, would narrow this a lot.
